name: you-only-figure-once
description: Create source-grounded scientific overviews through detailed template-led ImageGen prompts, visual approval, faithful editable reconstruction and selective real-data replacement.

interface.shortDescription: Scientific Figure Assistant — design, draw and review.
interface.longDescription: Sivia turns manuscripts into concrete scientific scenes, uses detailed template-led ImageGen prompts with a per-figure length floor, then faithfully reconstructs approved visuals as editable PowerPoint or draw.io objects. Real image fields and computed data are inserted from verified sources. Approved layouts stay fixed during micro-edits. Designer, Drawer, Reviewer and Corrector separate scientific content, visual fidelity and editability checks. Windows PowerPoint uses background COM batches; macOS Office.js and PowerPoint/WPS OOXML backends retain their declared capabilities.
defaultPrompt: 在 PowerPoint 或 WPS 中分面板复刻这张参考图，优先使用原生可编辑对象，并反复检查修正后保存。
在 draw.io 中逐步复刻这张参考图，保持文字、图形、表格、图表和连接线可编辑。
根据手稿和参考模板，先写不短于模板的精细ImageGen提示词；生成视觉稿，经我确认后忠实复刻为可编辑PPT，并局部替换真实数据。
